Hope you're well. Finance at StellarNet raised PO 98765 for Redwood's monthly subscription and asked us to enroll Redwood as a vendor in our AP portal so the PO can be matched and payment routed. A few quick asks we need to complete to avoid hold-ups:

1) Remittance ID: preferred remittance identifier is REDWOOD-REMIT-UK (please put in your portal Remit ID/Reference field). This ensures payments hit the subscription ledger and are applied to PO 98765.

2) Bank details & EFT: We can provide an EFT instruction PDF and SEPA details — see link in the footer below. For security, we usually send bank wiring docs via a secure upload; if StellarNet needs them directly in the portal, let me know and I'll add them to the enrollment packet.

3) Tax/VAT: Redwood is registered for VAT in the UK (VAT GB999 8888 77). If your portal requires a scanned VAT certificate or self-cert, we can attach that to the record.

Next steps suggestion:
- You add Redwood using our company legal name: Redwood Inference Ltd.
- Use Remit ID = REDWOOD-REMIT-UK 
- Attach PO_98765.pdf to the vendor record and indicate payment method = EFT/SEPA.

Looping in Laura from Finance to confirm the packet and share the secure link for bank docs if needed.

Best,
